description: Find CPE strings by vendor+product (latest schema). Search for Common Platform Enumeration identifiers in the Vulners database.

product.description: Product name to search for (e.g., 'windows_10', 'chrome', 'http_server', 'java'). Case-insensitive.

size.description: Maximum number of CPE results to return. If None, uses server default.

vendor.description: Vendor name to search for (e.g., 'microsoft', 'google', 'apache', 'oracle'). Case-insensitive.

name: search_cpe
